description: Department of Labour - Notifying that the Cost of Living Index Number for the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing Trade for the Month of September 2016 being 113.3, the Special Allowance in respect of a normal working day in the Month of October, 2016 will be Rs. 637.77
categorisation: This gazette notification announces a special allowance payable to workers in a specific trade, based on the Cost of Living Index Number. This falls under public sector service conditions and benefits administration, specifically addressing wage adjustments for workers. It is issued by the Commissioner General of Labour and relates to public service administration rather than government structure/personnel changes, land, legal, commercial, electoral, or judicial matters.
